title: Australian Public Service Commission and Merit Protection Commissioner 2025-26 combined annual report
body: Australian Public Service Commission and Merit Protection Commissioner

summary.label: Generated summary: written by a model from the report text and checked against the cited pages.

sentences.text: The Merit Protection Commissioner's section reports on the office's statutory review functions under the Public Service Act 1999, including Code of Conduct reviews, promotion reviews and own motion audits.
sentences.support: We conduct merit reviews of employment decisions to make sure they are correct, fair and lawful.

sentences.text: The report records that 109 applications for review of Code of Conduct decisions were received in 2025–26, and that 40% of Code of Conduct decisions reviewed were set aside or varied.
sentences.support: We set aside or varied 40% of Code of Conduct decisions.

sentences.text: The Merit Protection Commissioner stated that in almost 40% of Code of Conduct decisions reviewed this year the office identified issues that required the original decision to be set aside or varied.
sentences.support: in almost 40% of Code of Conduct decisions reviewed this year we identified issues that required the original decision to be set aside or varied

sentences.text: The Commission's section reports on its performance against six measures for 2025–26, with four achieved, one substantially achieved and one partially achieved.
sentences.support: of our 6 performance measures we achieved the targets for 4 measures, substantially achieved the targets for one measure, and partially achieved the targets for one measure.
